meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 当账号已连接 xAI 时,Claude 会用 x_search 搜索 X 上的帖子:给时效性查询加日期范围、限定可信账号、把问题拆成 2-3 次搜索,并为每条结论附上 x.com 链接和所用查询记录;若 xAI 未连接,它会直说并改用网页搜索。
howto.when: 当你提到“X search”、“Twitter search”、“tweets”等关键词,或想了解 X 上人们的看法、需要社交信号时触发。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上最近关于 NVDA 的讨论,只看我信任的那几个账号
say.note: 会分账号和关键词两次搜索,并附链接

say.text: X 上这两天有什么人在聊这个新产品?
say.note: 会限定日期范围,交回 x.com 链接

say.text: 查一下这条 X 帖子下面的回复和引用
say.note: 针对单条帖子抓取回复

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude searches X via x_search: date-bounding time-sensitive queries, scoping trusted accounts, splitting into 2-3 searches, and citing x.com links plus the queries used. Without it, it says so and uses web_search.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “X search”, “Twitter search”, “tweets” and similar terms, or want to know what people are saying on X or need social signal.

say_en.text: Search X for recent NVDA talk, only from accounts I trust
say_en.note: Runs an account pass and a keyword pass, with links

say_en.text: What are people posting on X about this launch in the last two days?
say_en.note: Date-bounds the query and returns x.com links

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this X post
say_en.note: Fetches the thread for one post
